description.layout: Simple top bar (hamburger, centered logo mark, Sign in button). Centered hero: large bold H1 'Try GitHub, the complete developer platform', a supporting paragraph, and a prominent dark 'Start free for 30 days' button. Below, a vertical stack of plan cards (Free, Team, ...) each with plan name, one-line description, large price display ($0 / $4 USD per user/month), a full-width CTA button, and a collapsible 'Show features' row. The Team card sits inside a highlighted 'RECOMMENDED' banner treatment.
description.color_scheme: White background, black/near-black text and primary buttons, one blue accent used specifically for the 'RECOMMENDED' banner border to draw the eye to the suggested plan.
description.typography: Large bold serif-free H1, medium-weight plan names, a very large price numeral with smaller 'USD' and 'per user/month' riders for clear price hierarchy.
description.spacing_alignment: Plan cards are centered, consistent width, generous internal padding, clear visual separation via card borders and shadow. CTA buttons are full-card-width and vertically aligned across cards.
description.accessibility_signals: High contrast black-on-white throughout. CTA button labels are descriptive ('Join for free', 'Continue with Team') rather than generic 'Click here'. 'Show features' looks like a disclosure control but no visible expand/collapse icon state shown in this capture.
description.notable_elements: Price-anchoring hierarchy (huge numeral), a single visually highlighted recommended-plan banner, stacked (not side-by-side) plan cards at this viewport width.
